You have never heard of this show. You just watched this whole clip (descriptions in brackets are what is on screen; speakers are described by how they look):
[On screen: Slow push-in on the figure in period dress as the lamp flickers behind them.]
[Action: the figure in period dress kneels on the slick quay boards.]
a figure in period dress: "Mother will see you hang for this."
[Sound: Glass shatters on stone.]
[On screen: Extreme close-up on the figure in period dress's eyes, wet with sea spray.]
a man in period dress: "The boat leaves at the turn of the tide. Be on it."
[Hard cut]
[On screen: Extreme close-up on the figure in period dress's eyes, wet with sea spray.]
a figure in period dress: "Expose me and her father hangs beside me."
[On screen: Close-up on the man in period dress's hands gripping the rail.]
a figure in period dress: "Take the girl to the cells until morning."
[Sound: A string sting swells to a peak.]
[On screen: Over-the-shoulder shot from the figure in period dress toward the the figure in period dress.]
a figure in period dress: "Order! I will have order in my hall!"
[On screen: Extreme close-up on the man in period dress's eyes, wet with sea spray.]
a man in period dress: "I saw who slipped the ring into your shawl."
[On screen: Over-the-shoulder shot from the figure in period dress toward the widow.]
a man in period dress: "They are coming up the cliff path with lanterns!"
